Narrowed at W160 2026-09-09, after the branch fired on six agents across four unrelated graphs and every one of them was algebraic: front_wing/ground_effect's SUSP (a two-line spring k(h0-h)=L), cooling_loop's four lumped coolant legs, and powertrain's actuator disk.
